arStrings.szText: Each strike from {c_important}Rampage{/c} sends a second smash forward.

{c_important}Rampage{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and summons a larger demon that deals {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. Recast to command the demon to leap around the battlefield, dealing {c_number}{payload:JUMP_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage with a {c_number}[{SF_30}|%|]{/c} chance per hit to Knock enemies Down for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds.
Killing an enemy or Demon with {c_important}Rampage{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[{SF_40}*100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Rampage{/c} compels your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to generate {c_number}[{SF_43}|1|]{/c} Wrath per hit for {c_number}{SF_45}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Rampage{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_44}|%|]{/c} chance to trigger its {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c}, {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}, or Knockdown hit effect when striking unaffected Elite enemies.

{c_important}Rampage{/c} now smashes your {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[{SF_46}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_46]){/c}.

{c_important}Rampage{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} {c_important}Mobility{/c} leap attack that transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:LEAP_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage with a {c_number}[{SF_16}|%|]{/c} chance per hit to grant you {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} seconds.
